messages:
Olga (People Ops): quick coordination: final checklist for next week's calibrations + a couple of edge cases. please skim.
Ken (Eng Manager): outline?
Olga (People Ops): 1) confirm reviewer coverage 2) mark LOA/parental in tracker 3) recusal/conflict flags 4) evidence fallback 5) timeboxes (3-5m). note on 2: we need explicit tag if someone is on parental or medical leave.
Hannah (Manager): tagging — one of my direct reports is returning from parental leave mid-cycle. do we treat their review differently?
Olga (People Ops): good Q. policy: if return <2 weeks before lock, use manager judgment and flag as "post-leave review" in the tracker. People Ops will do a QA pass and include a short note in the export.
Samir (IC): also: if a calibrator needs to recuse (worked closely with the IC), what's the swap flow?
Olga (People Ops): recusal: mark the case with "recuse:<name>" in reviewer comments, then select a backup calibrator from the public slot doc. If no backup, flag People Ops and we'll reassign.
Ken (Eng Manager): thing about conflicts: can a delegate approve late-evidence exceptions for the original manager?
Olga (People Ops): yes delegates may approve but must use the approval code flow. we log approver and whether they're a delegate. if policy requires the primary manager, People Ops will flag during QA.
Hannah (Manager): upload fallback question : my team uses large design files. when forms time out, should we put a drive link in reviewer comments or email People Ops?
Olga (People Ops): preferred: internal drive link in reviewer comments (access set to company). if that's not possible, email people-ops@redwood with subject: "REVIEW-EVIDENCE + <employee>" and include manager note. we'll ingest.
forms-bot: Reminder: NA lock 03/31 23:59 PT; EMEA 04/02 23:59 CET. Late exceptions require manager note + approval code.
legal-bot: Note: for post-leave reviews, retain documentation consistent with leave privacy rules. Keep sensitive medical details out of reviewer comments.
Samir (IC): small ops ask: can we add an optional "sensitivity" flag for comments that People Ops should treat as private?
Olga (People Ops): yes : adding a "private-note" checkbox to the reviewer form. Private notes are visible to manager + People Ops only and excluded from exports.
Ken (Eng Manager): timebox reminder: please include 4-min default in invites. helps keep sessions on schedule.
Olga (People Ops): will add 4-min default and a quick 1-line checklist to each invite. final ops checklist: 1) update public slot doc with delegates 2) mark LOA/post-leave cases 3) enable private-note where needed 4) confirm drive links or email fallback 5) post banner about calibration windows. ping me if you need a swap before EOD. :thumbsup:
